title: Manual regrading
privateDraft: Saving a draft does not change the student's grade or send a notification. Publish updates the grade and the existing in-app notification bell only.
scale: {count} active questions. Each question contributes up to {maximum}/10. Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100 (normalized score 0 to 1, in steps of 0.01). Totals use unrounded contributions; displayed values are rounded only for readability.
staleDraft: The published grade has changed since this draft was based on it. Review all scores, then save a new draft before publishing.
invalidScore: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100
noQuestions: No active questions. This submission cannot be regraded.
reasonHelp: {count}/2000 characters. Saved with the draft and retained in publication history.
saved: Private draft saved. The published grade is unchanged.
published: Grades published. The student can now see the new result.
noHistory: No manual regrading has been published yet.
publishWarning: The saved per-question scores will replace the published grade. The student will see the new grade and receive an in-app notification. This action is recorded in history.
unsavedWarning: There are unsaved changes or a request in progress. Leaving or reloading may discard local edits. Continue?
loadError: Could not load the workspace. Check your connection and retry.
saveError: The save result could not be confirmed. Reload the current workspace before trying again.
publishError: The publication result could not be confirmed. Reload the current workspace to check whether it was published.
conflict: This workspace changed in another session. Reload the latest revision and review it before saving or publishing again.
forbidden: Only the lecturer responsible for this exam can regrade this submission.
notFound: This submission or exam could not be found.
editsPreserved: Local edits have been kept. Reloading replaces them only after your confirmation when there are unsaved changes.
